## Multi-Property Comparison

Comparing multiple properties to see which offers the best 2-year outlook.

import pandas as pd

# Property comparison data
properties = {
    'Property': [
        '2.09/28 Waterloo Quay, Pipitea',
        '211/22 Herd St',
        '6/93a Kelburn Pde',
        '1/28 Martin Square',
        'Theoretical (Current)'
    ],
    'Asking Price': [701000, 625000, 595000, 605000, 800000],
    'Body Corp (annual)': [28001.45, 10610.05, 11248.00, 6153.15, 7000],
    'Rates (annual)': [4552.99, 6279.37, 4634.41, 3801.45, 5000],
    'Total Annual Costs': [32554.44, 16889.42, 15882.41, 9954.60, 12000],
    'Bedrooms': [2, 1, 2, None, None],
    'Floor Area (m²)': [111, None, 130, None, None],
    'Title': ['Stratum in Leasehold', '', '', '', ''],
    '2yr Outcome': ['Rent by 30k', 'Buy by 4.3k', 'Buy by 7.7k', 'Buy by 19.7k', 'Buy by 7.5k']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(properties)

# Display the comparison
print("="*90)
print("PROPERTY COMPARISON - 2 YEAR OUTLOOK")
print("="*90)
print("\nAssumptions:")
print("  - Infinite income capacity (can afford any mortgage)")
print("  - Difference between rent and house costs is invested")
print("  - Same investment return assumptions across all properties")
print("\n")

# Format and display
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
pd.set_option('display.width', None)
pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth', None)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "="*90)
print("KEY INSIGHTS")
print("="*90)

# Calculate metrics
df['Monthly Cost'] = (df['Body Corp (annual)'] + df['Rates (annual)']) / 12
df['Cost per m²'] = df.apply(lambda x: x['Total Annual Costs'] / x['Floor Area (m²)'] if pd.notna(x['Floor Area (m²)']) else None, axis=1)

print(f"\n📊 Price Range: ${df['Asking Price'].min():,.0f} - ${df['Asking Price'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"   Median: ${df['Asking Price'].median():,.0f}")

print(f"\n💰 Annual Costs Range: ${df['Total Annual Costs'].min():,.0f} - ${df['Total Annual Costs'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"   Median: ${df['Total Annual Costs'].median():,.0f}")

print(f"\n🏆 Best 2-Year Outcome: {df.loc[df['2yr Outcome'].str.contains('Buy by').fillna(False)].sort_values('2yr Outcome', ascending=False).iloc[0]['Property']}")
print(f"   Result: {df.loc[df['2yr Outcome'].str.contains('Buy by').fillna(False)].sort_values('2yr Outcome', ascending=False).iloc[0]['2yr Outcome']}")

print(f"\n⚠️  Worst 2-Year Outcome: {df.loc[df['2yr Outcome'].str.contains('Rent by').fillna(False)].iloc[0]['Property']}")
print(f"   Result: {df.loc[df['2yr Outcome'].str.contains('Rent by').fillna(False)].iloc[0]['2yr Outcome']}")

# Extract numeric values from outcomes
def extract_outcome_value(outcome_str):
    if 'Buy by' in outcome_str:
        return float(outcome_str.split('Buy by ')[1].replace('k', '')) * 1000
    elif 'Rent by' in outcome_str:
        return -float(outcome_str.split('Rent by ')[1].replace('k', '')) * 1000
    return 0

df['Outcome Value'] = df['2yr Outcome'].apply(extract_outcome_value)

print(f"\n📈 Range of outcomes: ${df['Outcome Value'].min():,.0f} to ${df['Outcome Value'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"   Spread: ${df['Outcome Value'].max() - df['Outcome Value'].min():,.0f}")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ((ax1, ax2), (ax3, ax4)) = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 12))

# Shorten property names for display

for i, name in enumerate(short_names):
    ax1.annotate(name, (df['Asking Price'].iloc[i], df['Outcome Value'].iloc[i]),

ax1.axhline(y=0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5)

ax1.set_ylabel('2-Year Outcome ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs 2-Year Wealth Outcome', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.text(0.02, 0.98, 'Green = Buy wins\nRed = Rent wins', transform=ax1.transAxes, 
        fontsize=10, va='top', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

# 2. Annual Costs Comparison
x_pos = np.arange(len(short_names))
bars1 = ax2.bar(x_pos, df['Body Corp (annual)'], label='Body Corp', color='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax2.bar(x_pos, df['Rates (annual)'], bottom=df['Body Corp (annual)'], 
               label='Rates', color='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Property', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Annual Cost ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Annual Ownership Costs Breakdown', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax2.set_xticklabels(short_names, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add total labels on bars
for i, (bc, rates) in enumerate(zip(df['Body Corp (annual)'], df['Rates (annual)'])):
    total = bc + rates
    ax2.text(i, total + 500, f'${total:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', 
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 3. 2-Year Outcome Bar Chart
colors_bars = ['red' if val < 0 else 'green' for val in df['Outcome Value']]
bars = ax3.barh(short_names, df['Outcome Value'], color=colors_bars, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=2)
ax3.axvline(x=0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2)
ax3.set_xlabel('Wealth Difference ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('2-Year Outcome: Buy vs Rent', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Add value labels

    label = f'${abs(val):,.0f}'
    if val > 0:
        ax3.text(val + 500, i, label, va='center', ha='left', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='darkgreen')
    else:
        ax3.text(val - 500, i, label, va='center', ha='right', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='darkred')

                     c=df['Outcome Value'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.7, 
                     edgecolors='black', linewidth=2, vmin=-30000, vmax=20000)
for i, name in enumerate(short_names):
    ax4.annotate(name, (df['Asking Price'].iloc[i], df['Total Annual Costs'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=9, ha='center', va='top', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Asking Price ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Annual Costs ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price vs Running Costs (colored by outcome)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('2yr Outcome ($)', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\n" + "="*90)
print("VISUALIZATION INSIGHTS")
print("="*90)
print("\n📊 Top-Left: Higher prices don't guarantee better outcomes")
print("📊 Top-Right: Annual costs vary dramatically (3x difference!)")
print("📊 Bottom-Left: Martin Square has the best buy advantage despite mid-range price")
print("📊 Bottom-Right: Waterloo Quay has high costs AND favors renting - double whammy!")

# Create a detailed ranking table
print("="*90)
print("PROPERTY RANKING BY 2-YEAR OUTCOME")
print("="*90)

# Sort by outcome value (best to worst)
df_ranked = df.sort_values('Outcome Value', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
df_ranked['Rank'] = range(1, len(df_ranked) + 1)

# Create analysis columns
df_ranked['Monthly Costs'] = (df_ranked['Body Corp (annual)'] + df_ranked['Rates (annual)']) / 12
df_ranked['Cost %'] = (df_ranked['Total Annual Costs'] / df_ranked['Asking Price']) * 100

# Display ranking
print("\n")
for idx, row in df_ranked.iterrows():
    rank_emoji = '🥇' if idx == 0 else '🥈' if idx == 1 else '🥉' if idx == 2 else '📍'
    
    print(f"{rank_emoji} RANK #{row['Rank']}: {row['Property']}")
    print(f"   {'─'*70}")
    print(f"   Price: ${row['Asking Price']:,.0f} | 2yr Outcome: {row['2yr Outcome']}")
    print(f"   Monthly costs: ${row['Monthly Costs']:,.2f} ({row['Cost %']:.2f}% of price annually)")
    
    if pd.notna(row['Bedrooms']):
        print(f"   Bedrooms: {int(row['Bedrooms'])} | ", end='')
    if pd.notna(row['Floor Area (m²)']):
        print(f"Floor Area: {int(row['Floor Area (m²)'])} m²", end='')
    if row['Title']:
        print(f" | Title: {row['Title']}", end='')
    print()
    
    # Add recommendation
    if row['Outcome Value'] > 10000:
        print(f"   ✅ STRONG BUY: Expected to outperform renting by ${row['Outcome Value']:,.0f}")
    elif row['Outcome Value'] > 0:
        print(f"   ✓ Marginal buy: Small advantage of ${row['Outcome Value']:,.0f}")
    elif row['Outcome Value'] > -10000:
        print(f"   ⚠️  Marginal rent: Small disadvantage of ${abs(row['Outcome Value']):,.0f}")
    else:
        print(f"   ❌ AVOID: Renting is ${abs(row['Outcome Value']):,.0f} better")
    
    print()

print("="*90)
print("FINAL RECOMMENDATIONS")
print("="*90)

best = df_ranked.iloc[0]
worst = df_ranked.iloc[-1]

print(f"\n🎯 BEST OPTION: {best['Property']}")
print(f"   Why: Lowest running costs (${best['Total Annual Costs']:,.0f}/year) with strong 2yr outlook")
print(f"   {best['2yr Outcome']} advantage over renting")

print(f"\n❌ WORST OPTION: {worst['Property']}")
print(f"   Why: Extremely high running costs (${worst['Total Annual Costs']:,.0f}/year)")
print(f"   {worst['2yr Outcome']} - renting is much better here")

# Cost efficiency analysis
print(f"\n💡 COST EFFICIENCY:")
most_efficient = df_ranked.sort_values('Cost %').iloc[0]
least_efficient = df_ranked.sort_values('Cost %').iloc[-1]
print(f"   Most efficient: {most_efficient['Property']} ({most_efficient['Cost %']:.2f}% annual cost ratio)")
print(f"   Least efficient: {least_efficient['Property']} ({least_efficient['Cost %']:.2f}% annual cost ratio)")

print(f"\n📏 SIZE MATTERS:")
with_area = df_ranked[df_ranked['Floor Area (m²)'].notna()]
if len(with_area) > 0:
    best_sqm = with_area.sort_values('Cost per m²').iloc[0]
    print(f"   Best value per m²: {best_sqm['Property']} (${best_sqm['Cost per m²']:,.2f}/m² annual cost)")

print(f"\n⚠️  SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS:")
leasehold = df_ranked[df_ranked['Title'].str.contains('Leasehold', na=False)]
if len(leasehold) > 0:
    print(f"   Waterloo Quay: Stratum in LEASEHOLD - investigate ground rent & lease terms!")
    print(f"   This could significantly impact long-term value and saleability")

# Core comparison function
def complete_comparison(n_months, prop_growth=None, inv_return=None):
    """
    Compare renting vs buying over n_months period.
    
    Returns detailed breakdown of both scenarios including leverage effects.
    """
    if prop_growth is None:
        prop_growth = property_growth_rate
    if inv_return is None:
        inv_return = investment_return_rate
        
    years = n_months / 12
    
    # SCENARIO A: RENT + INVEST DEPOSIT
    total_rent = monthly_rent * n_months
    invested_deposit_value = deposit * (1 + inv_return) ** years
    investment_gains = invested_deposit_value - deposit
    
    # SCENARIO B: BUY WITH MORTGAGE
    total_interest = interest_paid(P, r, c, n_months)
    total_ownership_costs = C * (n_months / 12)
    
    property_future_value = property_price * (1 + prop_growth) ** years
    property_capital_gains = property_future_value - property_price
    remaining_loan = principal_remaining(P, r, c, n_months)
    equity = property_future_value - remaining_loan
    
    # NET WEALTH POSITIONS
    rent_net_wealth = invested_deposit_value - total_rent
    buy_net_wealth = equity - total_interest - total_ownership_costs
    
    wealth_difference = buy_net_wealth - rent_net_wealth
    
    return {
        'months': n_months,
        'years': years,
        # Rent scenario
        'total_rent': total_rent,
        'invested_deposit_value': invested_deposit_value,
        'investment_gains': investment_gains,

# Core comparison function
def complete_comparison(n_months, prop_growth=None, inv_return=None):
    """
    Compare renting vs buying over n_months period.
    
    Returns detailed breakdown of both scenarios including leverage effects.
    """
    if prop_growth is None:
        prop_growth = property_growth_rate
    if inv_return is None:
        inv_return = investment_return_rate
        
    years = n_months / 12
    
    # SCENARIO A: RENT + INVEST DEPOSIT
    total_rent = monthly_rent * n_months
    invested_deposit_value = deposit * (1 + inv_return) ** years
    investment_gains = invested_deposit_value - deposit
    
    # SCENARIO B: BUY WITH MORTGAGE
    total_interest = interest_paid(P, r, c, n_months)
    total_ownership_costs = C * (n_months / 12)
    
    property_future_value = property_price * (1 + prop_growth) ** years
    property_capital_gains = property_future_value - property_price
    remaining_loan = principal_remaining(P, r, c, n_months)
    equity = property_future_value - remaining_loan
    
    # NET WEALTH POSITIONS
    rent_net_wealth = invested_deposit_value - total_rent
    buy_net_wealth = equity - total_interest - total_ownership_costs
    
    wealth_difference = buy_net_wealth - rent_net_wealth
    
    return {
        'months': n_months,
        'years': years,
        # Rent scenario
        'total_rent': total_rent,
        'invested_deposit_value': invested_deposit_value,
        'investment_gains': investment_gains,
        'rent_net_wealth': rent_net_wealth,
        # Buy scenario  
        'total_interest': total_interest,
        'total_ownership_costs': total_ownership_costs,
        'property_future_value': property_future_value,
        'property_capital_gains': property_capital_gains,
        'remaining_loan': remaining_loan,
        'equity': equity,
        'buy_net_wealth': buy_net_wealth,
        # Comparison
        'wealth_difference': wealth_difference,
        'better_option': 'Buy' if wealth_difference > 0 else 'Rent'
    }
